profile.headline: Operations Research Analyst, Software Engineer
profile.summary:
With customer focus, an entrepreneurial spirit, operations researcher heart, and keen analytical mind, Mr. Reed achieves success by quick learning and self-improvement to deliver timely, effective results.

He is seeking opportunities to apply his abilities as a Senior Software Engineer, Operations Research Analyst, or other analysis related field.  Relocating from Maryland in 2016 to provide a warmer climate for his spouse’s medical needs, Harry prefers to remain in the Clearwater/Tampa, Florida area.

AREAS OF EXPERTISE

Research & Development: Operations research analysis, performance assessment, trade space analysis, algorithm & process development, and modeling & simulation.

Software & Computer: Requirements identification & management, software engineering, C/C++, UNIX/Windows, and JAVA.  Object oriented, AGILE/SCRUM, waterfall design experience.

Production: Physical & software product development, and human factors/man-machine interface & user experience engineering.

Business: Efficiency & quality improvement, lessons learned, Lean Six Sigma, project management, and business capture & development.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Middle tier C++ developer for the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs.  Middle-tier website coding logic bug fixes, new feature additions, and analysis of results.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* On-time delivery of effective, object oriented software solutions as a middle-tier C++ developer in an agile, waterfall design environment to improve or repair a VA, complex adaptive, web service product.
  - Exhibited proficiency in working with legacy, large, complex software systems, tracking behavior and crafting enhancements.
- Demonstrated knowledge of tools and methods supporting application design and development employing the VA’s 4-pillar general development methodology (Define Problem, Investigate Alternatives, Develop Solution, and Try/Assess Solution) like Lean’s Plan, Do, Check, & Act.
* Satisfied Web Service Change Requests, Defects, and other support actions using Dimensions, SoapUI, UNIX, PL/SQL Developer, and Jazz.

positions.title: Signals Intelligence Analyst, Modeling and Simulation Subject Matter Expert
positions.description:
* Developed data visualization training course for Intel customer.
* Trade space analysis for Army leadership, future tech investment
  - Established requirements and metrics from guidance and specs.
  - Performed M&S to verify design claims using MatLab, Java, and C++.
  - Conducted cost, benefit, readiness risk analyses.
* Served as Project Technical Lead for Army Rotorcraft Sensor Model
  - With Project Gov’t lead, briefed consumers attracting $2M funding.  
  - Ensured proper quantitative & qualitative data & error handling.
  - Tested strategies for sufficient scenario range & world variation.
  - Led contractors to produce meaningful (audience tailored) results.

positions.title: Operations Research Analyst - Series 1515
positions.description:
* Analyzed Army Acquisition Lifecycle Lessons Learned (LL) conducting deep dive analyses and surveys of major Army programs.
- Highly successful ground-up mission and methods development.
- Composed trend reports published in Army Acq. & Tech. Magazine.
- Crafted prototype LL mining tools using Access, SQL, Excel, & VBA.
- On-site customer caregiver role to two Army Program Exec. Offices.
* Successfully implemented statistical methods with human interfaces to support the Army Acquisition Risk Analysis Team.
- Contributed to the launch of a patented, risk analysis method.
- Performed best distribution fit tests using Excel VBA and @Risk.
* Acted as an EM/Radar Subject Matter Expert to performed analysis of alternatives studies employing deep critical thinking to support or deny claims by Army request for information (RFI) and request for proposal (RFP) responses.
- Corrected legacy methods for EM propagation through desert storms.
- Developed M&S software using C++ in both IRIX (UNIX) & Windows env.
- Effectively applied imaginative thinking to fill data gaps.
- Presented recommendations to stakeholders saving $1.2B DoD funds.

company.name: U.S. Army Materies Systems Analysis Activity

positions.title: Principal Geospatial Engineer & Chief Sensor Fusion Scientist
positions.description:
* Lead Data Mining & Modeling Eng. for Phase II NTEX (see below)
- As the Data Mining & Modeling Team leader for Phase II, applied and extended creation technology developed under Phase I to support real, critical, agency missions.
- On-time delivery of 15, highly detailed, mission-tuned, target description databases contributed to Phase II successful completion.
- Earning ‘highly successful’ praise, the product is still in use.
* Created a web tool prototype to attract and expand customer interest within the NTEX effort.  The tool, written in C++ and Java / Java 3D on an SGI/IRIX (UNIX) platform empowered customer image analysts to create simulated target signatures for comparison to real image signatures.
* Established and led a User Experience Engineering Team to test customer acceptance of product design variations, demonstrating business, leadership, and process/software development skills.
- Re-tasked NTEX, web-based tools to simulate product variation.
- Further tested prototype look & feel by stereo lithography (3D printing) after favorable results employing the web-based tool.

positions.title: Senior Project Engineer
positions.description:
* Lead Data Mining & Modeling Eng for NTEX Ph. I (major DoD/IC effort)
- As the Data Mining & Modeling Team leader, built hierarchical databases for Bayesian-fusion (IR/RADAR/EO) data analysis applying past approximation strategy knowledge to identify key needs and interweave multiple technologies’ needs into a single database.
- Created software tools using C++ in an Object Oriented, Agile development environment to streamline the database creation process including simulation of movable parts and human error detection.
- Established and maintained stakeholder relationships by identifying and interacting with numerous DoD and Intel Community actors.
- Quality and timely delivery of M&S input databases directly contributed to NTEX Phase I success, resulting in customer funding of Phase II (above).

educations.degreeName: Working on MS in Program Management (OR Focus)

certifications.name: DAIWA SPRDE Level II - Systems Engineering
certifications.title: DAIWA SPRDE Level II - Systems Engineering

volunteerExperiences.role: Senior Modeling and Simulation Process Instructor
volunteerExperiences.description: 3rd of 3 years selecting area high school students at random to form four teams of three students each to learn the art of creating high resolution, 3-D mathematical models to support visualization, range of motion, and other kinds of analysis applications.  Students were taught field data collection strategies and tools (including surface measurement with laser ranging theodolites) through field exercises including large civilian (fire equipment) and military (tanks and trucks).  Field data reduction and arrangement processes were instilled to support capture using Rhino 3D (for surface modeling) and BRL-CAD (for true Combinatorial Solid Geometry [CSG] modeling) of all interior and external components.  Students then polished their CAD models and crafted presentations to community and industry leaders (from several Army laboratories and government contractor offices) describing their efforts and model design goals/analysis focus.  Many students gained experience, otherwise unavailable, that encouraged them to pursue successful careers in the modeling and simulation technology field.
